```{r setup, echo=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
source("cholera_climate_review/Analysis/utils.R")

# Load the dataset from the file path
data <- readr::read_csv(params$data_path)
```

## Exposure summary
```{r Exposure Count Summary}
# Total number of observational studies
total_studies <- n_distinct(data$studykey)

# Exposure counts
exposure_counts <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, exp_class) %>%
  count(exp_class, name = "n_studies")

exposure_counts %>%   knitr::kable()
```

Out of the **`r total_studies`** included observational studies, there were:
- **`r exposure_counts$n_studies[exposure_counts$exp_class == "precipitation"]`** precipitation studies  
- **`r exposure_counts$n_studies[exposure_counts$exp_class == "temperature"]`** temperature studies  
- **`r exposure_counts$n_studies[exposure_counts$exp_class == "flood"]`** flood studies  
- **`r exposure_counts$n_studies[exposure_counts$exp_class == "drought"]`** drought studies

## Study Locations by Continent
```{r Study Locations by Region and Continent}
region_table <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, eff_country, new_admin) %>%
  rename(admin_level=new_admin) %>% 
  add_continent(country_col = "eff_country") %>% 
  distinct(studykey, continent) %>%
  count(continent, name = "n_studies")
region_table %>%
  knitr::kable()

```
### Study Locations by Continent by exposure
```{r}
region_table_by_exposure <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, eff_country, new_admin,exp_class) %>%
  rename(admin_level=new_admin) %>% 
  add_continent(country_col = "eff_country") %>%
  distinct(studykey, exp_class, continent) %>%
  count(continent, exp_class, name = "n_studies")
region_table_by_exposure %>%
  knitr::kable()

```

## Spatial Scale Summary
```{r Spatial scale summary}
spatial_counts <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, new_admin) %>%
  count(new_admin, name = "n_studies")

spatial_counts %>%
  knitr::kable()
```
### Spatial scale summary by exposure
```{r}
spatial_counts_by_exposure <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, new_admin,exp_class) %>%
  count(new_admin, exp_class,name = "n_studies")

spatial_counts_by_exposure %>%
  knitr::kable()
```


### Study population summary
```{r Study population summary}
case_class <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, out_class_case_presentation) %>%
  mutate(case_type = case_when(
    out_class_case_presentation == "bacteriologically confirmed cases only" ~ "Confirmed",
    out_class_case_presentation == "suspected cases only" ~ "Suspected",
    out_class_case_presentation == "not stated" ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ "Mixed"
  )) %>%
  count(case_type, name = "n_studies")

case_class %>%   knitr::kable()
```


## Study population summary by exposure
```{r}
case_class_by_exposure <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, out_class_case_presentation,exp_class) %>%
  mutate(case_type = case_when(
    out_class_case_presentation == "bacteriologically confirmed cases only" ~ "Confirmed",
    out_class_case_presentation == "suspected cases only" ~ "Suspected",
    out_class_case_presentation == "not stated" ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ "Mixed"
  )) %>%
  count(case_type, exp_class, name = "n_studies")

case_class_by_exposure %>%   knitr::kable()

```


## Paper quality summary
```{r Summarize statistics for data}
stats_all <- generate_summary_stats(data)
study_counts <- stats_all$study_counts
stats_all$quality_summary %>% knitr::kable()
```

## Direction of effect and vote Counting Summary
```{r}
vote_counts <- stats_all$vote_counting_summary
vote_counts %>%  knitr::kable()
```

### Temperature

```{r}
vc_temp <- vote_counts %>% filter(exposure == "temperature")
vc_temp  %>%  knitr::kable()
```

- **Positive**: `r vc_temp$direction_counts[[1]]["positive"]`  
- **Negative**: `r vc_temp$direction_counts[[1]]["negative"]`  
- **No Effect**: `r vc_temp$direction_counts[[1]]["none"]`  
- **Null hypothesis**: `r ifelse(vc_temp$p_value < 0.05, paste0("rejected (p = ", round(vc_temp$p_value, 3), ")"), paste0("not rejected (p = ", round(vc_temp$p_value, 3), ")"))`

### Precipitation


- **No Effect**: `r vc_flood$direction_counts[[1]] %>% pluck("none", .default = 0)`
